newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman shares continue to rise in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares continue to rise in active trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange continued to rise in the week to Wednesday in active trade focused on banking and investment stocks, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The stock market index climbed 0.8 percent to 328.72 points from 326.13 a week earlier.
Total trade value more than doubled to 28.8 million rials from 14.1 million, while the number of shares changing hands soared to 6.9 million from 3.4 million last week.
Of the 70 stocks traded, 28 rose, 24 declined and 18 were unchanged.
Oman National Holding Co was among the most active stocks this week with 715,000 shares worth 5.1 million rials traded. The stock extended last week's gains, closing at 7.100 rials from 6.250.
Some 388,000 shares of the National Bank of Oman worth 3.4 million were traded. The stock dipped to 8.340 rials from 8.850 rials the previous week.
Al Ahlia Portfolio Securities closed at 8.880 rials from 8.150 rials a week earlier.
Shares in Bank Muscat al Ahli al Omani retraced some of last week's gains, slipping to 7.750 rials from 8.230 last week.
National Biscuit Industries ended the week at 6.100 rials from 5.500 rials.
Banking and investment shares accounted for 91 percent of trade, followed by industrials with four percent, services with four percent and insurance stocks with one percent. ($1=0.377 rials)
